Subject.primary: A joyful traditional Tamil family celebrating the Pongal harvest festival in a rural Tamil Nadu village

A woman wearing a vibrant traditional silk saree with jasmine flowers in her hair
Children dressed in traditional Tamil festive clothing
cultural_elements: A traditional clay pot filled with freshly harvested rice and milk
Fresh turmeric plants tied around the pot
Decorated native cattle with colorful but respectful adornments
